description: Removes products from a list on the signed-in shopper's account, by list_id and product id. A product that is not on the list is reported and ignored. Requires sign-in.

slug.description: Alternative to product_id: the product's url, or the slug-and-id at its end.

market.description: Market for the links and prices in the answer: dk, se, de or no.

name: remove_from_my_wishlist
title: Remove products from my list
